about: Khrabrovo: Kaliningrad International Airport. The 39,762 sq. m passenger terminal is designed for 5 million passengers a year, with 6 jet bridges on the apron. One runway 3,350 × 45 m.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Bus No. 244-Э runs between the airport and Yuzhny bus station in Kaliningrad, average journey time 45 minutes. Departures may be up to 15 minutes late; the timetable may change.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Two business lounges on Level 2 airside: Kurshsky Zaliv for domestic flights in sector A and Dyuny for international flights in sector C. Admits business class passengers and anyone who has paid for entry; veterans of the Great Patriotic War with an escort free of charge.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: RecoRoom Sonnik capsule hotel on the airport grounds: hourly rates, automated check-in, single and double capsules with space for baggage, power sockets and free Wi‑Fi.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: The mother and child room is free for departing passengers with children under 7, disabled children under 14 and women in the second half of pregnancy; it follows the terminal's hours. First you need a certificate from the first-aid post on Level 1, in the right part of the building; baggage is left at the left luggage office.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Short-stay parking from 01.10.2026: first 15 minutes free, then 400 ₽ for each hour, including a part hour. Long-stay 900 ₽ per day. Free car park for 300 cars 400 m from the terminal. Parking on the first lane in front of the building is prohibited.
